hooks.command: $j = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $cmd = $j.tool_input.command; if ($cmd -match 'git add -f') { Write-Output '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "BLOCKED: git add -f bypasses .gitignore. Ask user before force-adding files."}'; exit 1 }; if ($cmd -match 'git tag') { $pr = (gh pr view --json state -q '.state' 2>$null); if ($pr -ne 'MERGED') { Write-Output '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "BLOCKED: git tag before PR merge. Confirm PR is merged first."}'; exit 1 } }

$j = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $fp = if ($j.tool_input.file_path) { $j.tool_input.file_path } else { $j.tool_response.filePath }; if ($fp -and $fp -match '\.dart$') { flutter analyze --no-pub $fp }
